## Modelling SMDW outcomes

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Random forest modelling for SMDW outcomes
# Reads final training datasets, adds country-level covariates,
# and uses PSU-based weights instead of household-count weights
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(h2o)
library(here)
```

### 1. Prepare training datasets

```{r}
#1. Read final training datasets
training_dir <- here::here("./data/training_subcomponents")

smdw_training_with_covariates <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(training_dir, "smdw_training_with_covariates.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

ecoli_training_with_covariates <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(training_dir, "ecoli_training_with_covariates.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

improved_source_training_with_covariates <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(training_dir, "improved_source_training_with_covariates.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

availability_training_with_covariates <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(training_dir, "availability_training_with_covariates.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

accessibility_training_with_covariates <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(training_dir, "accessibility_training_with_covariates.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
outcome_col <- "outcome_value"
```

### 2. Modelling SMDW subcomponents

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 4. Helper to create RF input data
# ============================================================

create_rf_training_data <- function(training_df, outcome_name) {
  
  
  model_features <- intersect(all_predictor_features, names(training_df))
  
  train_data <- training_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      model_name = outcome_name,
      country_eval = as.character(.data[[country_col]]),
      country_fold = as.factor(as.integer(factor(country_eval))),
      model_weight = as.numeric(.data[[weight_col]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(model_features),
      dplyr::all_of(outcome_col),
      model_weight,
      country_eval,
      country_fold,
      country_outcome,
      HH7_region_outcome,
      analysis_year
    ) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(
      dplyr::all_of(outcome_col),
      model_weight,
      country_eval,
      country_fold
    )
  
  list(
    data = train_data,
    features = model_features,
    outcome_name = outcome_name
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Remove Pakistan from all training datasets before modelling
# ============================================================

remove_pakistan <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !stringr::str_detect(
        stringr::str_to_lower(country_outcome),
        "^pakistan"
      )
    )
}

smdw_training_with_covariates <- remove_pakistan(
  smdw_training_with_covariates
)

ecoli_training_with_covariates <- remove_pakistan(
  ecoli_training_with_covariates
)

improved_source_training_with_covariates <- remove_pakistan(
  improved_source_training_with_covariates
)

availability_training_with_covariates <- remove_pakistan(
  availability_training_with_covariates
)

accessibility_training_with_covariates <- remove_pakistan(
  accessibility_training_with_covariates
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
#Start H2O
# ============================================================


h2o::h2o.init(
  nthreads = -1,
  max_mem_size = "12G"
)

h2o::h2o.no_progress()
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 7. Helper to run RF with leave-one-country-out CV
# ============================================================

run_rf_loco <- function(rf_input, ntrees = 500, seed = 123) {
  
  train_data <- rf_input$data
  model_features <- rf_input$features
  outcome_name <- rf_input$outcome_name
  
  train_h2o <- h2o::as.h2o(
    train_data,
    destination_frame = paste0("train_", outcome_name)
  )
  
  rf_model <- h2o::h2o.randomForest(
    x = model_features,
    y = outcome_col,
    training_frame = train_h2o,
    ntrees = ntrees,
    mtries = -1,
    sample_rate = 0.632,
    fold_column = "country_fold",
    weights_column = "model_weight",
    seed = seed,
    keep_cross_validation_predictions = TRUE,
    keep_cross_validation_fold_assignment = TRUE
  )
  
  cv_predictions <- h2o::h2o.getFrame(
    rf_model@model$cross_validation_holdout_predictions_frame_id$name
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  cv_eval <- train_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      predicted = cv_predictions$predict,
      observed = .data[[outcome_col]]
    )
  
  metrics <- tibble::tibble(
    outcome_name = outcome_name,
    n_rows = nrow(train_data),
    n_countries = dplyr::n_distinct(train_data$country_eval),
    n_features = length(model_features),
    xval_r2 = as.numeric(h2o::h2o.r2(rf_model, xval = TRUE)),
    xval_mae = as.numeric(h2o::h2o.mae(rf_model, xval = TRUE)),
    xval_rmse = as.numeric(h2o::h2o.rmse(rf_model, xval = TRUE))
  )
  
  variable_importance <- h2o::h2o.varimp(rf_model) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(outcome_name = outcome_name)
  
  list(
    model = rf_model,
    cv_eval = cv_eval,
    metrics = metrics,
    variable_importance = variable_importance,
    features = model_features
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 8. Run RF models for all four outcomes
# ============================================================
rf_smdw <- run_rf_loco(rf_input_smdw)
rf_ecoli <- run_rf_loco(rf_input_ecoli)
rf_improved_source <- run_rf_loco(rf_input_improved_source)
rf_availability <- run_rf_loco(rf_input_availability)
rf_accessibility <- run_rf_loco(rf_input_accessibility)

rf_results <- list(
  ecoli_free = rf_ecoli,
  improved_source = rf_improved_source,
  availability = rf_availability,
  accessibility = rf_accessibility
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Plot CV predictions coloured by ww_region without rerunning RF
# ============================================================

plot_rf_cv_by_ww_region <- function(rf_result, training_df, plot_title) {
  
  ww_region_lookup <- training_df %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      country_outcome,
      HH7_region_outcome,
      analysis_year,
      ww_region
    )
  
  plot_data_cv <- rf_result$cv_eval %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      ww_region_lookup,
      by = c(
        "country_outcome",
        "HH7_region_outcome",
        "analysis_year"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ww_region = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(ww_region),
        "Missing ww_region",
        as.character(ww_region)
      )
    )
  
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data_cv,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = predicted,
      y = observed,
      size = model_weight,
      colour = ww_region
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    ggplot2::stat_smooth(
      se = TRUE,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      method = "lm"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Predicted outcome proportion",
      y = "Observed outcome proportion",
      size = "PSU weight",
      colour = "Wastewater region"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# Helper: print and save ggplot objects as SVG
# ============================================================


if (!requireNamespace("svglite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install the svglite package first: install.packages('svglite')")
}

plot_output_dir <- here::here("./outputs/04_model_performance/figures")

dir.create(
  plot_output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

print_and_save_svg <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 8, height = 6) {
  
  print(plot_obj)
  
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plot_output_dir, filename),
    plot = plot_obj,
    device = svglite::svglite,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in"
  )
}
```

```{r}
auto_label_feature <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    stringr::str_squish()
}


label_model_features <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  mapped <- dplyr::recode(
    x,
    !!!feature_label_map,
    .default = NA_character_
  )
  
  dplyr::if_else(
    is.na(mapped),
    auto_label_feature(x),
    mapped
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 13. SHAP summary plots for all four RF models
# ============================================================

library(viridis)
library(forcats)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: create SHAP plot from an existing RF result
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_shap_summary_plot <- function(
    rf_result,
    outcome_name,
    y_lab,
    sample_n = 2000
) {
  
  # Use the model-ready data already stored in rf_result$cv_eval.
  # No model rerun is needed.
  shap_df <- rf_result$cv_eval %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(rf_result$features))
  
  # Optional sampling to keep SHAP calculation faster
  if (nrow(shap_df) > sample_n) {
    set.seed(123)
    shap_df <- shap_df %>%
      dplyr::slice_sample(n = sample_n)
  }
  
  shap_h2o <- h2o::as.h2o(
    shap_df,
    destination_frame = paste0("shap_data_", outcome_name)
  )
  
  shap_summary_plot_h2o <- h2o::h2o.shap_summary_plot(
    rf_result$model,
    shap_h2o
  )
  
  shap_summary_plot_data <- shap_summary_plot_h2o[["data"]] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    feature_raw = as.character(feature),
    feature = label_model_features(feature_raw)
  )
  
  
  shap_summary_plot_data <- shap_summary_plot_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(contribution), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  shap_plot <- shap_summary_plot_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      feature = forcats::fct_reorder(feature, mean_abs_shap)
    ) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = feature,
        y = contribution,
        colour = normalized_value
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      position = h2o:::position_jitter_density(),
      alpha = 0.5,
      size = 1.2
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_gradientn(
      colours = viridis::viridis_pal()(9),
      breaks = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("low", "high"),
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste("SHAP summary:", outcome_name),
      y = y_lab,
      x = "",
      colour = "Normalized\nfeature value"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 9)
  
  list(
    plot = shap_plot,
    data = shap_summary_plot_data,
    h2o_plot = shap_summary_plot_h2o
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 14. Create SHAP plots for all four outcomes
# ============================================================

shap_SMDW <- make_shap_summary_plot(
  rf_result = rf_smdw,
  outcome_name = "SMDW",
  y_lab = "SHAP contribution to SMDW prediction",
  sample_n = 2000
)

shap_ecoli <- make_shap_summary_plot(
  rf_result = rf_ecoli,
  outcome_name = "ecoli_free",
  y_lab = "SHAP contribution to E. coli-free drinking water prediction",
  sample_n = 2000
)

shap_improved_source <- make_shap_summary_plot(
  rf_result = rf_improved_source,
  outcome_name = "improved_source",
  y_lab = "SHAP contribution to improved source prediction",
  sample_n = 2000
)

shap_availability <- make_shap_summary_plot(
  rf_result = rf_availability,
  outcome_name = "availability",
  y_lab = "SHAP contribution to drinking water availability prediction",
  sample_n = 2000
)

shap_accessibility <- make_shap_summary_plot(
  rf_result = rf_accessibility,
  outcome_name = "accessibility",
  y_lab = "SHAP contribution to drinking water accessibility prediction",
  sample_n = 2000
)
```
